reuse.why: Builds the guard on the existing shared linkBankSyncAccount path and db.first, but then also calls it from every provider wrapper instead of relying on that shared path.

duplication.why: The new guard is called once inside linkBankSyncAccount and again, redundantly, at the top of each of the five provider wrappers, re-deriving syncSource strings and account ids that linkBankSyncAccount already receives.

placement.why: assertBankAccountNotLinked sits in accounts/app.ts next to linkBankSyncAccount, where linking logic lives; the extra per-provider calls scatter the policy back into the wrappers.

scope.why: Only the guard, its calls and a release note are added.

maintainability.why: The rule itself is one function, but six call sites with hard-coded provider strings must stay consistent with the syncSource each wrapper passes, and a new provider wrapper could easily miss the early call.

bypasses_abstraction.where: The check is enforced inside the shared linkBankSyncAccount; the wrapper calls are redundant rather than a way around it.

disguised_duplication.where: The repeated wrapper calls are plain repeated calls to the same function, not reshaped copies of logic.

one_place.where: The uniqueness rule (non-tombstoned, same account_sync_source and account_id, other id) is defined once in assertBankAccountNotLinked in server/accounts/app.ts and every link path uses it, though it is invoked twice per path.
